decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Country Life," and two distinct albums share that title. Document D1S1 explicitly identifies Roxy Music as the artist of the 1974 album *Country Life*. Document D2S1 identifies Show of Hands as the artist of the 2003 album *Country Life*. Both are valid referents for the same album name, and neither source contradicts the other. Therefore, both answers are preserved.
